rows.ja: マカオの競合(カジノ運営権を持つ6社)

relations.text: Las Vegas Sandsが10-Kで、マカオの他の運営権者としてWynnの子会社を挙げる
relations.text_en: Las Vegas Sands names Wynn's Macau subsidiary among the other concessionaires

source.label: Las Vegas Sands 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The other concessionaires are SJM Resorts, S.A., Wynn Resorts (Macau), S.A., Galaxy Casino, S.A., MGM Grand Paradise, S.A. and Melco Resorts (Macau), S.A.

relations.text: Melcoが年次報告で、マカオの競合の運営権者としてWynn Macauを挙げる
relations.text_en: Melco names Wynn Macau among the Macau concessionaires it competes with

source.label: Melco Resorts 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Wynn Macau, a subsidiary of Wynn Resorts Ltd.;

companies.name: ギャラクシー・エンターテインメント

relations.text: Wynnが10-Kで、マカオでカジノを運営できる他社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Wynn names it among the other companies permitted to run casinos in Macau

source.label: Wynn Resorts 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In addition to Wynn Resorts (Macau) S.A. ("Wynn Macau SA"), SJM Resorts, S.A. ("SJM"), Galaxy Casino, S.A. ("Galaxy"), Venetian Macau, S.A. ("Venetian Macau"), Melco Resorts (Macau) Limited ("Melco"), and MGM Grand Paradise Limited ("MGM Macau") are permitted to operate casinos in Macau

relations.text: Wynnが10-Kで、マカオでカジノを運営できる他社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Wynn names it among the other companies permitted to run casinos in Macau

source.label: Wynn Resorts 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In addition to Wynn Resorts (Macau) S.A. ("Wynn Macau SA"), SJM Resorts, S.A. ("SJM"), Galaxy Casino, S.A. ("Galaxy"), Venetian Macau, S.A. ("Venetian Macau"), Melco Resorts (Macau) Limited ("Melco"), and MGM Grand Paradise Limited ("MGM Macau") are permitted to operate casinos in Macau

relations.text: Wynnが10-Kで、マカオの運営権者として、またボストンでの競合(MGM Springfield)として挙げる
relations.text_en: Wynn names MGM as a Macau concessionaire and, via MGM Springfield, a Boston-area competitor

source.label: Wynn Resorts 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Encore Boston Harbor competes with both commercial and Native American casinos located in the northeastern U.S., including two Native American casinos in Connecticut, two casinos in Rhode Island, and MGM Springfield in Massachusetts.
